name: Grime Gorger
oracle_text:
Menace
Whenever this creature attacks, exile up to one card of each card type from defending player's graveyard. Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature for each card exiled this way.
blocked_sentences: Whenever this creature attacks, exile up to one card of each card type from defending player's graveyard. Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature for each card exiled this way.

needs.what: a choice over cards in a zone constrained to 'up to one card of each card type': the chosen set must be assignable so that no card type (artifact, battle, creature, enchantment, instant, kindred, land, planeswalker, sorcery) is represented by more than one chosen card, so a multi-typed card (artifact creature) uses up every type it has; here over the defending player's graveyard, exiled with an `as` binding whose count feeds add_counters on self
needs.why_existing_wont_do: search_zones/exile carry `count` and `distinct_names` but no distinct-card-types constraint (`any_type` there is the mana-spending permission). A for_each over a list of types exiling one card per type is not exact: it lets an artifact creature be taken as the artifact and a second creature card as the creature, exiling more cards (and adding more counters) than the printed card allows
